title: Key Unlocks Enabling Finance Companies to Scale AI/GenAI
description: Finance companies are scaling AI/GenAI by leveraging foundation models, RAG pipelines, secure private-cloud deployments, and cost-efficient fine-tuning techniques. On the data side, unified data lakes, real-time streams, synthetic data, and strong data governance frameworks provide the fuel for safe, compliant AI use. Together, these technology and data unlocks enable financial firms to build trusted, scalable GenAI solutions across risk, fraud, compliance, advisory, and automation.
keywords: Key Unlocks Enabling Finance Companies to Scale AI/GenAI

title: How Operating Model in Enterprises are changing with GenAI
description: Large enterprises are shifting from static, process-driven operations to dynamic, GenAI-powered workflows centered on data, prompts, and AI governance. This transformation flattens organizational boundaries, accelerates experimentation, and introduces new roles like prompt engineers and AI auditors.
